$comment: GENERATED — do not hand-edit. Regenerate with: pnpm build:record-pep-build
algorithm: sha256, updated with each module's filename then its bytes, in the order given by `modules`; first 12 hex characters of the digest
why: PromptForge cannot compute this. The plugin sources live only in this repository, so PromptForge can be told what the current build is but can never derive it — and without being told, its enforcement-point check can only prove the agents agree WITH EACH OTHER. A fleet where every gateway is equally stale has no internal disagreement to observe and passes silently, which is P-121's original scenario and exactly what a missed deploy produces. See P-138.
